General Frequently Asked Questions

How to dispute a transaction on my account with UBA?

Please call the customer fulfillment center on 07002255822 or send an email to cfc@ubagroup.com

Why is my UBA account showing balance unavailable?

This may be due to an error or network issues. Please log out and log in again. If challenge persists please call the customer fulfiment center on 07002255822

What is NUBAN?

NUBAN is your bank account number

What is the maximum transfer on UBA mobile app?

Maximum transfer limit on the mobile app is 200,000 and be extended to a maximum of 5 million naira only

Why is the UBA mobile app not working?

This may be due to an error or network issues. Please log out and log in again. If challenge persists please call the customer fulfiment center on 07002255822

What is my UBA mobile banking id?

Your mobile banking ID is your mobile number

What is UBA mobile transfer limit?

Maximum transfer limit on the mobile app is 200,000 and be extended to a maximum of 5 million naira only

What is UBA prepaid card limit?

4 Million- International
300,000- Local

What is UBA transfer limit per day?

Transfer Limits may vary based on class of account or what digital channel is being used for the transaction

How can I increase my transaction limit on UBA mobile app?

Visit setting,>>self service>> transfer limit to increase your limit

What is UBA internet banking transfer limit?

Retail – 10 Million Daily
SME-500 Million
Corporate – 1Billion

How to increase transfer limit on UBA app?

Visit setting,>>self service>> transfer limit to increase your limit

What is stamp duty charge?

The Federal Government of Nigeria (FGN) released a policy directing all banks to apply a Stamp Duty Charge of N50 when you receive N10,000 and above effective February 1, 2020. This fee is remitted straight to the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN).

Each time, I want to transact, I get transaction limit exceeded; what could be wrong and how can it be resolved?

Please confirm what limit is applicable to you from the table above. You may need to give an instruction and execute indemnity at any of our Business Office for higher limits

I am interested in UBA’s Internet Banking Service, but I am not in a country with UBA Presence, how do I enroll?

You can enroll on Internet Banking without visiting a UBA Business Office by clicking on download at the top of this page and clicking on the link for enrollment over the internet, you would require the latest version of Adobe reader on your PC and an image of an acceptable means of identification to apply. The form can be returned via email, by sending the completed form to: virtual.enrollment@ubagroup.com

How can I enroll/register for Internet Banking?

There are flexible options for enrollment/registration. They include:

  • Instant Self-Registration – with your debit card, individual customers can start and finish enrollment from our Internet Banking login page ibank.ubagroup.com by clicking Instant Self-Registration button. It takes about 40s to complete this process!
  • Enrollment with Virtual Enrollment Form – There is also another option for both individuals and corporates to enroll with the interactive online PDF forms. The link to the forms are pasted below:
    • U-Direct Virtual Channel Enrollment Form – Individual
    • Internet Banking Virtual Channel Enrollment Form – Corporate
  • Enrollment through our Business Offices – You can walk into any of our Business Offices to fill a form to be enrolled on Internet Banking. Corporate customers can also give instruction on their letterhead to RMs or Business Offices to enroll their desired users – there is no limit to the number of users who can be enrolled under a corporate user
Can I view all my accounts with UBA PLC using one Internet Banking log-in ID?

Yes, when you enroll for UBA’s Internet Banking Service, Internet Banking, You Can specify which accounts you want access to over the internet and can have access to all of them using one single user ID.

How Do I Reset my Password?

On Internet Banking Home Page, https://ibank.ub agroup.com, please click on forgot your password? Link, enter your Internet Banking USER ID on next screen and submit, then provide an answer to any security question set by you and a new password is automatically generated and sent to your registered e-mail address.

I have not used Internet Banking in a long time; how can I start again?

Getting started again is easy! Click forgot user ID? To retrieve your user ID, then, click forgot password? to retrieve your password. Now, you are good to go

I want to know more about what Internet Banking has to offer. How can I go about it?

Please click the link Internet Banking Quick Guide for more info. If you need further assistance, kindly contact cfc@ubagroup.com

How secure is the Internet Banking platform and how can I further secure my profile?

Our Internet Banking is very secure, we have gone to great extent to protect you and your funds when using Internet Banking, you have two level authentication (password + token) available each time you transact on Internet Banking, we have also introduced an Image and Phrase Security feature to guard against phished site.  In Addition, there’s the virtual keyboard for use on open networks and public spaces so that key loggers will not capture your details.

Internet Banking is protected with the best-in-class security technology. To further protect your profile, do not share your credentials with anyone, do not click on any suspicious link, when you are in doubt, always contact cfc@ubagroup.com

How can I access Internet Banking? Is it available as a downloadable app to phones?

Internet Banking can be accessed from any internet-enabled devices – computer, laptop, smart phones etc. via https://ibank.ubagroup.com. For ease of access and use, you can download Internet Banking apps from stores.

I have received my log-in credentials with an attached PDF in my inbox; how do I access my log-in credentials?

In Nigeria, all accounts use the NUBAN system, all accounts are 10 digits, your login credentials are in the PDF attached to the mail you received, the PDF has been pass-coded using the last 7 digits of ANY of your 10-digit account numbers with UBA Plc, as a hint, the last 3 digits of the account used is stated in the body of the e-mail you received.

Can I change my user ID? How often can it be changed?

You can change your USER ID anytime you wish. Kindly click on My profile >>> Security settings >>> Update My User ID. Authenticate with Secure pass / Token and click submit.

AGMESIS Loan

What is AGSMEIS?

AGSMEIS means Agri-Business Small and Medium Enterprise Investment Scheme is a loan of 5% per annum implemented by the central bank of Nigeria through UBA as a disbursing bank for empowering potential entrepreneurs with the necessary equipment and working capital to kick start their businesses.

What are CBN EDIs?

Central Bank of Nigeria Entrepreneurship Development Institutions are public and private institutions approved by the Central Bank of Nigeria to carry out vocational and entrepreneurship training for Entrepreneurs and SMEs

Who can apply for AGSMEIS?

All Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in the Agriculture sector, Education, Manufacturing, Service sector, including Information and Communication (ICT) and the Creative Industry

Must I be a UBA customer before I can access this loan?

Yes. UBA will be the disbursement bank for your loan amount since it is paramount you have an account with the bank.

Must I have to be certified by an Entrepreneurial development institute before I am qualified to access this loan?

YES. To be qualified to assess this loan you need to be trained and certified by any of CBN approved Entrepreneurial Development Centers closest to you. Accredited EDIs are all over the nation.

Do I need collateral for this loan?

In an instance of asset acquisition; the asset acquired becomes the collateral and must be registered with National Collateral Registry(NCR).
For Working Capital Loan of N500,000 and below; the collateral is Personal Guarantee of the borrower.
If the working capital is above N500k, the obligor will submit a receipt of assets previously purchased, to cover the balance of the exposure

Who do I submit my application form to?

Only eligible entrepreneurs that have been trained and certified will submit their application forms to the EDIs indicating United Bank for Africa as the disbursing bank for onward submission to CBN.

If I am already in business, do I need to be certified by the entrepreneurial institutes to be qualified to access this loan?

One of the eligibility criteria is to be certified by a CBN approved Entrepreneurial development institutes.

How do I know where and who the Entrepreneurial development institutes are?

You can get this information from our SME page on our website or visit the closest branch to you, to inquire of an EDI closest to you.

Personal loans

What is Personal Loan?

Personal loan is an uncollaterised loan accessible to staff of approved companies, whose salary accounts are domiciled with UBA.

What is the minimum loan amount?

– If you are an employee of a private firm, the minimum loan amount you can apply for is N100,000 (One Hundred Thousand Naira only)
– If you are an employee of a civil organisation, the minimum loan amount you can apply for is N50,000  (Fifty Thousand Naira only).

What is the maximum loan amount I can apply for?

– If you are an employee of the private sector, the maximum loan amount you can apply for is N30,000,000.00 (Thirty Million Naira Only)
– If you are an employee of the civil service, the maximum loan amount you can apply for is N20,000,000.00 (Twenty Million Naira Only)

N.B: Maximum loan amount is subject to applicant’s net monthly/annual salary.

What is the maximum loan tenor for UBA Personal loan?

– A customer in the private sector can enjoy loans for a tenor up to 60 months.
– A customer in the civil service, you can get loans for a tenor of up to 48 months.

What are the other fees to be paid on UBA Personal Loan?

No hidden charges, No management fee

Is there a minimum and maximum age of eligibility?

Yes, applicant must not be less than 18 years at loan application date and should not be older than 55 years at loan maturity date.

What if I have an existing loan with other banks, can I still apply for a personal loan?

Yes, you can

  •  
How long does it take to access Personal Loan?

Personal Loan will be availed immediately after a successful application.

What are the criteria to access the loan?
  • Customer must maintain an active salary account with UBA.
  • Customer must not have a history of dud cheques.
  • Customer must have a satisfactory credit report.
How many times can I request for this loan?
  1. As many times as you may require, as long as you have not exceeded your eligible limit.
How do I apply for a loan?

– To apply for any of UBA Consumer loan, a customer walks into the nearest Business Office and submits an application or sends an E-mail to his/her Relationship Manager to process the loan request.
– Or apply through any of the bank’s channel; Leo, mobile app, internet banking

I want to apply for a loan, however, I do not have an account with UBA. What do I do?

To enjoy any of our loan products, you would need to open a UBA current account. Kindly walk into any UBA Business Office nearest to you or click here

What are the available consumer loans?

The loan products currently available is:
– The UBA Personal Loan Product
– Asset Finance
– Auto Loans

How do I know if I am eligible for a loan?

– To be eligible to obtain a loan facility, the following criteria are to be met:
– You must be a confirmed staff
– Your employer must be on the approved list of organizations for Personal Loans
– Net monthly salary should not be less than N12,000 (Twelve Thousand Naira).

I am yet to be a confirmed staff of my firm, can I still get a loan?

– No, please.

What documents am I required to provide to obtain a loan facility?

– To obtain the UBA Personal Loan, you would need to provide the following documents:
– A duly completed Loan Application Form.
– A copy of your pay slip and bank statement of account indicating salary inflows in the last 6 months.
– A letter of awareness from your current employer.
– A letter of Introduction and Awareness from your current employer.
– Positive credit search reports

I just started working at my company. When will I be eligible to apply?

– No, please. To be eligible to apply for the UBA Personal Loan Product, you must have been confirmed as a staff by your organisation.

Bumper Account

Can I still win N100k in the Bumper draw?

Yes! Just dial *919*20# to open a Bumper account, save N5,000 monthly and you could be the next winner.
To migrate your existing savings account, dial *919*20*1# only in Nigeria.

To see UBA subsidiary country codes click here

Who can open a UBA Bumper Account?

All individuals

How much do I need to open a UBA Bumper Account?
  • N6,500 and above
What do I stand to get for having a UBA Bumper Account?

Several exciting rewards such as a Grand prize of N 2million Naira cash reward, 100,000 naira shopping allowance per month for a year, consolation cash prizes of N500,000 and so much more.

What are the documents I need to open a UBA Bumper Account?
  • 1 Recent Passport Photograph
  • Valid means of ID
  • Utility Bill for Nigerian Nationals
  • Valid Resident Permit – for Foreign Nationals
  •  
Can I get a debit card on my UBA Bumper Account?

Yes, you can get a debit card on your UBA Bumper Account

I am not a Nigerian, can I still open a UBA Bumper Account?

Yes, for foreigners that reside in Nigeria

What is the UBA Bumper Targeted Draw?

It is a special draw conducted for customers in a group, cluster or location (associations, markets, organizations etc.) who open UBA Bumper accounts within a specific period. This means that only customers from an identified cluster will emerge as winners in the draw.

What is the objective of UBA Bumper targeted draws?

To promote credibility of the UBA Bumper Reward Scheme, increase product awareness and drive sales acquisition in specific areas.

What qualifies me for the UBA Bumper Account raffle draw?

Your UBA Bumper account number

Will accounts without BVN qualify for the draw?

No, please. Accounts without BVN will not be considered for the UBA Bumper targeted draw.

Will accounts without complete documentation qualify for the draw?

All accounts without complete documentation will not qualify for the draw. However, accounts with CAV pending can be considered for the draw.

Can customers who participate in a targeted draw also participate in the monthly & quarterly draws?

YES. These customers will still be eligible to win in the monthly and quarterly draws. (Subject to the qualifying criteria for these draws)

What are the prizes to be won?

– Rent for a year
– Shopping Vouchers
– Get paid for a year
– Cash prizes and lots more

Diaspora Account

How can I open a UBA Diaspora Account Abroad?

– Customer goes online via the web link https://aop.ubagroup.com/SignUpProcess/step2disapora
– Inputs all required data filled.
– Uploads document.
– Clicks on the submit button to open Diaspora account
– Downloads the video Banking app
– Signs up and logs in
– Initiate a call to authenticate document.
– A CFC Rep, downloads the contact details of customer, and initiate the call via WhatsApp video call to validates customer details and complete the account opening process.

FX Accounts

Where can I purchase foreign exchange?

The FX Mart service is available in all UBA Business Offices.

What is PTA/BTA?

PTA stands for Personal Travel Allowance.
BTA stands for Business Travel Allowance.

Do I have to be a UBA account holder to buy foreign currency from UBA FXMart?

No, UBA FX Mart will sell to both a ccount holders and walk – in customers.

Can a traveler buy all three currencies at the same time?

Absolutely, as long as the quarterly limit for PTA/BTA is not exceeded. The US dollar is the base currency.

Can I buy both PTA and BTA at once?

No, you can only purchase one allowance at a time.

Are children entitled to buy foreign exchange?

Foreign exchange can be purchased by holders of Nigerian passports who are 18 years and above

Can I still buy foreign exchange, even if I do not want up to my maximum travel allowance?

Yes you can. The minimum purchase amount is $100 or it’s equivalent in other currencies.

Does FXMart deal in all the currencies in the world?

At this time, FXMart only deals with the three major world currencies, US Dollar, British Pounds and the Euro.

Home Account

What is a HOME ACCOUNT?

The Home Account for Diasporas in Africa is a unique product that offers bank accounts with adjoining products in both the resident countries and in Nigeria at the point of onboarding.

Who are the primary target for HOME ACCOUNT?

– Every Nigerian who lives outside the shore of Nigeria within African countries with UBA presence.
– African Expatriates living in Nigeria.

What are the Benefits to the customer?

– One home transfer per month from Expatriate account to Diaspora account will be free of charges (Africash-based account-to-account transfers)
– Diaspora debit card will be free of charge
– Free Issuance on the first debit card
– Interest rate of 4.05% on the naira savings account
– Access to UBA global network
– Online account opening gives customers immediate access to banking facilities

What are the account opening documentations required?

– International Passport with valid Resident Visa or Work Permit
– Proof of Address (Utility Bill Not Exceeding Last 2 Months or Last 6 Months Bank Statement)
– The CRO sends an email to country of residence to verify and confirm the proof of address as provided in the document for Home  account to be opened.
– 2 passport photographs
– References for current accounts

Kiddies Account

How do I open a UBA KIDDIES Account?

Documents required
– Child’s birth certificate or International Passport
– 1 Passport Photograph each of parent/guardian and child ID
– Parent’s valid ID (National ID/ Driver’s License/ Permanent Voters card/ International Passport)
– Utility Bill within 3 months from account opening date

Who Operates the UBA KIDDIES Account?

-The parent/ guardian till the child comes of age

How much do I need to open a UBA KIDDIES Account?

-N1,000 (accounts opened on zero balance must be funded within 48 hours)

Can I get a debit card on the account?

No, however you can access the accounts via our other digital channels.

What do I stand to get for having a UBA KIDDIES Account?

Several exciting rewards such as:
– Earn 13th Month Reward.
– A chance to partake in the scholarship scheme.
– Annual interest of 4.05% (payable monthly)
– Complimentary invites to UBA Kiddies events.

Can I still open a UBA Kiddies account without a valid means of ID and utility bill?

Yes

What is the 13th month reward and how do I partake in this?

The 13th month reward is an amount paid to UBA kiddies customers at the end of each year. If they save according to their target plan and roll over their balance to the next year (not withdrawn). Kindly submit a standing instruction of a minimum of N5,000 to begin

Will I qualify for the 13th month bonus if I do not have a target saving plan?

NO, you will not qualify for the 13th month bonus if you do not have a target savings plan.

What happens to my 13th month bonus if I withdraw funds early?

If you withdraw funds early, you will not be eligible for the 13th month bonus that year.

However, your plan will remain in effect and you can be eligible the following year if you stick to your plan. In this case, your plan will revert to Year 1, so you will be eligible for a 10% bonus that year.

Will I still earn interest if I do not achieve my target plan?

Yes, you will earn competitive interest on the accumulated funds in your account even if you do not achieve your target plan – however, you will no longer be eligible for the 13th month bonus.

How do I sign up for the scholarship reward?
To begin, simply maintain a Standing Instruction of minimum of N10,000 for 6 consecutive months (Without withdrawals)

NextGen

How do I open a UBA NEXTGEN account?

Documents required
– A duly completed account opening form
– One passport photo of Student / Corp Member
Tier 1 KYC (partial): Student / departmental / faculty ID card / NYSC card (for Corp members)
Tier 3 KYC (full): Evidence of Studentship / Corps membership (e.g. Student  / Corp Member ID, Admission / Posting letter) ,  one of the following: Voter’s card / national ID / national driver’s license / international passport and one of the following: utility bill, school fees receipt, hostel allocation document

Funding
No minimum Opening Balance

I want a UBA NextGen Account, I am 18 years old, but I am yet to get admission into a tertiary institution?

A Savings account will be opened when you present a passport photograph and valid photo ID. However, with your School ID/admission letter, your account can be converted to a UBA NextGen account.

Do I have to be a student to open a UBA NextGen Account?

– Yes, please. The UBA NextGen Account is for students of any tertiary institution including Colleges, Universities, Technical/Vocational Institutions,  Polytechnics.
– National Youth Service Corps members with valid NYSC cards are also eligible for the UBA  NextGen Account.

What are the means of ID acceptable to open a UBA NextGen account?

– For Tier 1 KYC, the following means of ID are acceptable.

  • Student ID Card OR Departmental ID Card OR Faculty ID Card
  • NYSC ID card

– For Tier 3 KYC IDs, the following means of ID are acceptable.

  • International Passport OR Voters Card OR National ID OR Driver’s License; but must also provide evidence of being a student / corp member
What if I don’t have any of the primary means of ID?

The customer will need to provide an Admission Letter OR Clearance Letter OR Call up Letter that shows at least the following information: Passport Photo, Name, Sex, Student/Registration Nos., Faculty/Department.

Where can I open a UBA NextGen account?

– On Campus at University events organized by UBA
– On Camp
– Online
– At the Branch

Can I have a NextGen account and a Savings account at the same time?

You can, but if you are a Tertiary student or Corp member, the UBA NextGen account will better meet your needs than the General Savings account.

If I already have a Savings account, why do I need a UBA NextGen account?

– The Savings account is a basic savings account.
– As a Tertiary student or Corp member, the NextGen account will better meet your lifestyle needs.
– You stand a chance to win pocket money for a year in our targeted draws
– Your first debit card  is issued at only half the regular cost
– You get to attend all campus events

Will the student/corps member get a debit card if the account is not funded?

No – the account must be funded with at least the card fee (@ 50% discount) to get a debit card.

How much do I need to open a UBA NextGen Account?

 No minimum account opening balance

Can I get a debit card on my UBA NextGen Account?

– Yes, you can get a debit card on your UBA NextGen account at a discount of 50% for your first card.

What do I stand to get for having a UBA NextGen Account?

– A chance to win Pocket Money for a Year
– A chance to become a UBA campus Ambassador
– Complimentary invites to NextGen events and Master classes
– No sms charge and card maintenance fee
-And so much more

How do I qualify to win the pocket money reward?

– Simply open your account and maintain a minimum balance of N5000

SME

What is the SME Business Account?

The SME Business Account is designed to support micro, small and medium-sized businesses, which are deterred by CAMF charges to own a business current account. The UBA SME account will offer very minimum fees with lots of value-added propositions to enable MSMEs build capacity.

The account is in three variants, representing different turnover bands and monthly fees.

Which sectors are eligible to apply for this account?

All MSME sectors and segments with maximum annual turnover of N600MM

I wish to know if there is a maximum threshold for each band?
Each of the Variants have a band with a maximum limit at the Medium category.
PARAMETER MICRO SMALL SMALL
SCHEME CODE SMEMI SMSML SMMED
Opening Balance 20,000 100,000 500,000
Monthly Minimum Turnover Band N2.5M-9.99M N10M-49.99M N50M-100M
Fixed Monthly Charge (VAT Inclusive) N1,050 N5,250 N10,500
Default CAMF (if turnover falls below Minimum Turnover) N1/Mille on Turnover N0.9/Mille on Turnove N0.8/Mille on Turnover
Is the SME Business Account a COT-free account?

Cot free when customer achieves his/her minimum threshold.

Can an existing customer who has a personal current account be able to migrate to the new SME Business Account?

Yes. You can do a scheme code change for an active account. You can also resuscitate dormant account into this new account.

Which variant does customers with a monthly turnover of above 100 Million belong to

Customer with turnover above 100 Million can do the medium VARIANT of the SME account. We will only charge such customer a concessionary CAMF of N0.6/mille for the excess of 100 million in a particular month.

Is the Minimum opening balance the same as minimum operating balance for the SME Business Account?

There is no Minimum operating balance but a minimum opening balance.

If customer exceeds the maximum amount, will they be charged?

Customer is charged the Fixed Monthly Charge for the width the customer exceeded into.

What are the benefits of having an SME Business account?
  • Fixed Monthly Charges
  • Access to business loans
  • On boarding on digital collection solutions
  • Access to MSME masterclasses and advisory.
  • Access to the bank’s SME events and fairs.
  • Access to a free online marketplace (as applicable)

Teens Account

What is UBA Teens Account?

UBA Teens is a basic savings account for teenagers. The objective of the account is to give them a sense of inclusion in planning their finances, carrying out transactions and learning to save.

What are the key benefits of the UBA Teens Account?

– 50% discount on first debit card issuance
– 13th Month Reward with a maintenance of an SI for 12 months at a minimum of N5,000 (Target-Plan). 10% of the monthly Target plan amount is paid to the customer
– Consistent maintenance of SI above N10,000 for 6 month stand a chance to partake in the Scholarship scheme
– Opportunity for Internship with the Bank

What are the requirements for opening a UBA Teens Account?

Forms
– Personal Account Opening Form (To be completed by parents with parent’s information or with guardian’s information)
– Signature Specimen form (To be completed by parent or guardian)
Documents required
– Birth Certificate or international passport of the child/teenager.
– One passport photo each of parent or guardian and child/teenager
– Valid and acceptable means of Identification for parent/guardian (e.g. Intl. Passport/Driver’s License/Voters Card)
– Recent Utility bill
Funds
– Minimum Opening Balance of N3,000
– Minimum Operating Balance of N 1,000

Who Operates the UBA TEENS Account?

-The parent/ guardian till the child comes of age

Can I get a debit card on the account?

Yes. First issuance is at a discount of 50%.

Who can request for a UBA Teens card?

New-to-Bank Teen customers by completing the Teens Debit Card section of the Account Opening Form.
Existing Teen customers by completing the Teens Debit Card section of the Debit Card Request Form

How much do I have to pay for the debit card?

The debit card is at 50% discount  for first issuance  and the standard charge applies for lost or expired cards.

How can I check my child’s balance or recent transactions?

Parents/guardians can monitor teens’ account activity including balance information and recent transactions through online banking/Mobile App/USSD.

Can I transfer money from my child’s account to my account with UBA?

Yes. As the signatory on the account, you can transfer money from your child’s account to another account at UBA.

Can I transfer money into my child’s account?

Yes. You can either deposit cash or transfer into the account.

Can I transfer funds to a non-UBA Bank Account?

Yes. But Only from a full KYC Teens account

Can I still open a UBA TEENS account without a valid means of ID and utility bill?

Yes

What if a teen wants to change his/her transaction limit without the parent/guardian’s consent?

Transaction limits can only be defined and changed by parents/guardians. In addition, parents/guardians can monitor teens’ account activity through online/mobile/USSD banking.

Are other bank cheques allowed into UBA teens account?

Yes. But only for a full KYC Teens account

What is the 13th month reward and how do I partake in this?

The 13th month reward is an amount paid to UBA Teens customers at the end of each year. If they save according to their target plan and roll over their balance to the next year (not withdrawn). Kindly submit a standing instruction of a minimum of N5,000 to begin.

Will I qualify for the 13th month bonus if I do not have a target saving plan?

NO, you will not qualify for the 13th month bonus if you do not have a target savings plan

What happens to my 13th month bonus if I withdraw funds early?

If you withdraw funds early, you will not be eligible for the 13th month bonus that year.

However, your plan will remain in effect and you can be eligible the following year if you stick to your plan. In this case, your plan will revert to Year 1, so you will be eligible for a 10% bonus that year.

Will I still earn interest if I do not achieve my target plan?

Yes, you will earn competitive interest on the accumulated funds in your account even if you do not achieve your target plan –however you will no longer be eligible for the 13th month bonus.

How do I sign up for the scholarship reward?

To begin, simply maintain a Standing Instruction of minimum of N10,000 for 6 consecutive months (Without withdrawals)

Zero Instant Savings Account

What is the UBA Zero Account ?

The Zero Instant Savings Account is a savings account that can be opened without immediate funding. It is designed to encourage the unbanked and the under-banked to open a savings account.

What are the requirements for opening a UBA Zero Account?

– One Passport Photograph
– Name
– Telephone number
– Address
– Place and Date of birth
– Gender

How much can I deposit in an instant ?

Maximum single deposit of N50, 000.

Do I have to visit the branch to open an account?

No, simply click to dial *919*20#  or open a zero account via our website.

Can I obtain a debit card ?

Yes

UBA Internet Banking

Who can use UBA’s Internet Banking?

Internet Banking is available to both Corporate and Retail Banking Customers. You can carry out secure online transactions, payments of all types, and also monitor initiated transactions.

How can I access Internet Banking? Is it available as a downloadable app to phones?

Internet Banking can be accessed from any internet-enabled device – computer, laptop, smart phone etc. via https://ibank.ubagroup.com.

How can I enroll/register for Internet Banking?

There are 3 ways to register for Internet Banking

Instant Self-Registration

o Visit https://ibank.ubagroup.com and click the “Instant Self-Registration” button to start and complete the enrolment process. It takes less than 2 Minutes to complete

Enrolment via account opening:

o Visit any UBA branch to open an account and get enrolled on Internet Banking during this process .

Enrolment with an Internet Banking Enrolment Form:

o This option allows individual and corporate account holders to enroll using our interactive online PDF forms listed below.

  • – Internet Banking Virtual Channel Enrolment Form {Hyperlink text}
  • – Individual Internet Banking Virtual Channel Enrolment Form – Corporate

Enrolment through our Business Offices:

  • – Existing customers can walk into any of our branches to fill in an Internet Banking enrollment form.
  • – Corporate customers can write instruction to enroll their desired users using their letterhead and submit to RMs or Business Offices – there is no limit to the number of users who can be enrolled under a corporate user
Sometimes I get a ‘transaction limit exceeded’ message, how can I fix this?

This happens when you are trying to perform a transaction above your current transaction limit. To increase your transaction limits, simply  You may need to give an instruction and execute indemnity at any of our Business Office for higher limits.

Can I access The Internet Banking Platform 24/7?

Yes, our internet banking platform is available 24/7 and is accessible anywhere in the world.

I entered the wrong password three times and have now been locked out of the platform, what do I do?

If you have forgotten your password, you can reset it by selecting the forgot password option on the sign in page, type in your USER ID and follow the prompts.

What must my password contain?

Your password must contain a minimum of six characters and alphanumeric.

Can I change my user ID? How often can it be changed?

You can change your USER ID at any time. Click on My profile >>> Security settings >>> Update My User ID. Authenticate with Secure pass / Token and click submit.

If I forget my hard token, can I use my soft token?

Yes, you can use either your hard token or soft token to complete your transaction.

I forgot my USER ID, what should I do?

On Internet Banking Home Page, https://ibank.ubagroup.com , please click on Forgot your USER ID. Enter your account number, click submit and your USER ID will be sent to your registered e-mail address.

Can I view all my UBA accounts using one Internet Banking login ID?

Yes, when you enroll on Internet Banking, You can specify which accounts you want access to using your user ID.

How do I reset my password?

On Internet Banking Home Page, https://ibank.ubagroup.comm, click on forgot your password, enter your Internet Banking USER ID and submit. You will be asked to provide the answer to any security question you set at registration and a new password is automatically generated and sent to your registered e-mail address.

How can Corporate users can reset passwords for other users in same company?

Corporate users with Approval/Authorizer roles can reset passwords for all users in the same organization by following the steps below.

  1. – Log in to https://ibank.ubagroup.com/
  2. – Click on MENU > MORE > CORPORATE ADMINISTRATION > ACCESS MANAGEMENT > MAINTAIN USER ACCESS DETAILS.
  3. – Search for the User you wish to reset password, click on the name then Click Set Password.
  4. Select the Set password box and click Continue
  5. – Enter secure Pass response and Click Submit

You will see a confirmation message and the user will receive a password reset email immediately.

I only just received my new password and it has expired?

Your new password expires after 1hr if you don’t activate.

However, you can still use the expired password to trigger a new password. On the Internet Banking site, enter your User ID with the expired password and click on RESEND. A new password will be sent to your registered phone number and email address.

I have not used Internet Banking in a long time, how can I start again?

Getting started again is easy! Click forgot user ID to retrieve your user ID, then, click forgot password to retrieve your password.

How can I learn more about the UBA Internet Banking?

Click the link Internet Banking Quick Guide for more info. If you need further assistance, kindly contact cfc@ubagroup.com

How secure is UBA Internet Banking platform and how can I further secure my profile?

Our Internet Banking platform is very secure. Some of the platform’s security features include;

  1. – Two level authentication (password + token) available each time you transact on Internet Banking
  2. – Image and Phrase security feature to guard against phished sites.
  3. – Virtual keyboard for use on open networks and public spaces so that key loggers are unable to capture your account details.

UBA Internet Banking platform is protected with the best-in-class security technology. To further protect your profile, do not share your credentials with anyone, do not click on any suspicious link, when you are in doubt, always contact cfc@ubagroup.com.

I have received my login credentials with a PDF attached, how do I access the PDF as it contains my login credentials?

In Nigeria, all accounts use the NUBAN system, all accounts are 10 digits, your login credentials are in the PDF attached to the mail you received, the PDF has been pass-coded using the last 7 digits of ANY of your 10-digit account numbers with UBA Plc, as a hint, the last 3 digits of the account used is stated in the body of the e-mail you received.

How can I get a token and how much does it cost?

You can get a hard token device at any UBA branch at N2,500. For more flexibility, Secure pass (Software Token) is available for free in apps stores for download and instant activation for your transactions.

Can I initiate FX (Foreign Currency) transactions?

No please.

What does my Corporate user ID look like?

Your user ID is your company name, dot, your first name. For example: DoeLimited.John.

What can I do with my corporate internet banking?
  • – Bulk upload transfers
  • – Bill Payments
  • – Flight Payments
  • – Account Statement download
Is UBA Internet Banking for Corporate available for download on my mobile

 Yes, Authorizers can use the Internet Banking App to authorize payments.

What file format can I upload when using the Bulk Upload Feature for funds transfers?

The acceptable file formats include; Excel, Txt and CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files.

Can I use the Internet Banking service for Corporates to initiate international fund transfers?

Yes, you can.

How many approvers can approve a fund transfer?

The platform supports multilevel approvals. You can specify the number of approvals required to complete transactions. Transactions will only be processed once approved by the final approver.

Is there a Checker functionality of the platform?

Yes, there is a checker process. The verifier authenticates what the initiator has uploaded and the Authorizer validates as the final approval.

Can I download statements from the platform?

Yes, statements can be download in in PDF, Excel, MT940 formats.

Are Corporate customers required to use Token authentication at login?

No, token verifications are only required during file upload validation, transaction verification and final authorization.

How do I know if a transaction has been initiated and is waiting for my authorization?

The verifier and the Authorizer will receive an email notification. There is also a notification button on the dashboard that shows the awaiting approval icon.

I have not used my profile in a long time, how do I retrieve my User ID?

Customer can customer can click on ‘forgot User ID’ and input your account Number and your User ID will be sent an email to the registered Email Address.

I have not used my profile in a long time and have forgotten my password, how do I reset?

To reset your password, click on ‘Forgot Password’ on the login page, input your User ID and follow the on screen prompts

What type of transactions can I use the Bulk upload feature for?
  • – Multiple debit, Multiple credit
  • – Single Debit, Multiple credit.
  • – NAPs Single Debit, Multiple Credits
  • – NEFT
How many transactions can be uploaded in each of these upload files?
  • – Multiple debit, Multiple credit – Maximum of 50 Transaction per upload
  • – Single debit, Multiple credit – Maximum of 50 Transaction per upload
  • – NAPs Single Debit, Multiple Credits – Maximum of 5,000 transactions per upload to other Banks.
  • – IFT (UBA – UBA) – Maximum of 5,000 transactions per upload
How can transactions be rejected/discarded?

Once a transaction is initiated, the approver can choose to reject using the steps below:

– For Multiple Debit, Multiple Credit (MDMC), on-screen and prepaid card transactions;

  • Menu>> Transactions >> status of transaction >> view approval queue >> click on the multi-records actions dropdown to reject or via a click on the arrow for more options

– For Bulk uploads:

  • Menu>> Transactions >> BULK Uploads>> Approve/reject Uploaded files >> click on the arrow for more options>> You can then either approve/reject/view transaction history.
How can I view Details of Bulk Transactions?

– NAPS and NEFT Transaction Details

  • Menu>> Transactions >> Bulk Uploads >> Select view NAPs uploaded file details for NAPS transactions or Select view NEFT uploaded file details for NEFT transactions>> Click on the transaction which you want to view and the details will be displayed as seen below. This can also be downloaded in either Excel/PDF/Txt format.

– To View Other Bulk Payments (SFU, MDMC, SDMC AND Card Payment Upload)

  • Menu>> Transactions >> status of transaction >> view completed transactions >> Find the transaction via the search criteria
How can I view Individual transaction status?

Menu>> Transactions >> status of transaction >> view transactions history >> select the transaction by clicking on Entry ID>> Details will be displayed as seen in the attached and can be downloaded in Excel/PDF/Txt format

How can I to initiate Multiple transactions on screen?

Menu>> Transactions >> Initiate Funds Transfer >> Initiate Multiple transactions>> Fill in the required details to proceed.

Note: New records can be added if necessary as it can accommodate up to 30 records at once

AGMESIS Loan

What is AGSMEIS?

AGSMEIS means Agri-Business Small and Medium Enterprise Investment Scheme is a loan of 5% per annum implemented by the central bank of Nigeria through UBA as a disbursing bank for empowering potential entrepreneurs with the necessary equipment and working capital to kick start their businesses.

What are CBN EDIs?

Central Bank of Nigeria Entrepreneurship Development Institutions are public and private institutions approved by the Central Bank of Nigeria to carry out vocational and entrepreneurship training for Entrepreneurs and SMEs

Who can apply for AGSMEIS?

All Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in the Agriculture sector, Education, Manufacturing, Service sector, including Information and Communication (ICT) and the Creative Industry

Must I be a UBA customer before I can access this loan?

Yes. UBA will be the disbursement bank for your loan amount since it is paramount you have an account with the bank.

Must I have to be certified by an Entrepreneurial development institute before I am qualified to access this loan?

YES. To be qualified to assess this loan you need to be trained and certified by any of CBN approved Entrepreneurial Development Centers closest to you. Accredited EDIs are all over the nation.

Do I need collateral for this loan?

In an instance of asset acquisition; the asset acquired becomes the collateral and must be registered with National Collateral Registry(NCR).
For Working Capital Loan of N500,000 and below; the collateral is Personal Guarantee of the borrower.
If the working capital is above N500k, the obligor will submit a receipt of assets previously purchased, to cover the balance of the exposure

Who do I submit my application form to?

Only eligible entrepreneurs that have been trained and certified will submit their application forms to the EDIs indicating United Bank for Africa as the disbursing bank for onward submission to CBN.

If I am already in business, do I need to be certified by the entrepreneurial institutes to be qualified to access this loan?

One of the eligibility criteria is to be certified by a CBN approved Entrepreneurial development institutes.

How do I know where and who the Entrepreneurial development institutes are?

You can get this information from our SME page on our website or visit the closest branch to you, to inquire of an EDI closest to you.

What is Africash?

Why use Africash

All Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in the Agriculture sector, Education, Manufacturing, Service sector, including Information and Communication (ICT) and the Creative Industry

How long does it take to get money transfers?

Africash is online real-time. The beneficiary gets money instantly

How do I access this service?

The service can be used to send and receive money across UBA locations in Africa. Simply visit any UBA branch or agent locations across Africa and ask to send money with Africash

Who pays the charges for transfers?

The sender bears the cost and the charges are affordable.

Is the service secure?
Yes, the Africash service is secure. Beneficiaries need to present the following in order to access transfers;
  • – PIN code

What are the transfer limits?
Transfer limits vary per country
What happens if I lose the collection PIN?

Can a transaction be modified, cancelled and refunded?

Can I change my beneficiary details on a transfer?

Can transfers be made directly into Beneficiary's account?

Who has access to the service?

Are there Africash sub-agents in Nigeria?

Click credit

What is Click Credit?

It is a fully automated instant loan for salary earners. This is enabled on all our digital channels -USSD, Leo WhatsApp and Facebook, Mobile Banking, and Internet Banking.

How do I apply for click credit product?

Dial *919*28# or apply on any of our digital channels. (Leo, Mobile Banking and Internet Banking).

I want to apply for an instant loan, however, I do not have an account with UBA. What do I do?
To enjoy this product, you would need to operate a salary account with UBA. You could follow the easy steps provided by any of our e-channels which include:

  • Chat with LEO

What is the maximum loan amount I can apply for?

You can get up to N 1,000,000.00 (One million naira)

What is the maximum loan tenor?

You can enjoy a flexible loan tenor up to 12 months.

How long will it take to process a UBA Click Credit request?

No Processing and paperwork! Just dial away and obtain your loan in less than a minute!

How do I know if I am eligible for a loan?

To be eligible for the loan, customers must have received their salary through UBA for the last 6 months.

I am yet to be a confirmed staff of my firm; can I still get a loan?

Confirmation status of applicant in the place of employment is not required for loan eligibility.

What documents am I required to provide to obtain a facility?

No documents required. Once again, just dial awayyyyyy!

If I just opened a salary account with UBA, how long do I have to wait before I can apply for the Instant Loan?

You must have been receiving your salary through UBA for at least six months before you can be qualified for this product.

Are there fees to be paid to enjoy this product?

There are no fees on this product.

What is the applicable interest rate on this product?

The applicable interest rate is 21% p.a. (1.75% monthly)

UBA Moni

How can I identify a UBA Moni Agent?

Agents representing UBA will have a “UBA Moni Agent” signage as part of their identification in addition to other branding materials.

What kind of customers can agents serve?

All customers who want to deposit or withdraw cash, send money or intending customers who would like to open an account with UBA.

What type of services can I carry out at an agent location?

Apart from account opening, cash deposit, withdrawal and transfer, you can also register for Bank Verification Number (BVN) and pay bills.

Is my money safe with your agent?

Your transaction will be authenticated using soft token (OTP – One Time Password) before it is completed. You will also receive SMS notification from the bank as proof of your transactions.

I have friends who would like to become UBA Moni Agents. Can I introduce them to the Bank?

Our agents work closely with relationship managers who handle complaints promptly.

UBA Naira Credit Card

How do I get a UBA Naira Credit Card?
  • Simply walk into any UBA branch or visit our website at ubagroup.com to download the credit card application form, fill in and submit to the Customer Service Officer at any of our branches nationwide.
  •  
Who is eligible for the UBA Naira Credit Card?
  • Any employee of approved corporates whose salary account is domiciled with UBA
What are the benefits of the UBA Naira Credit Card?
  • – Easy access to cash with a revolving line of credit.
  • – Enjoy up to 45 days’ interest free credit.
  • – Flexible repayment option with as low as 10% minimum monthly repayment required.
  • – Enjoy amazing discounts at partner Restaurants & Hotels, Lounge access, etc. across the world.
  • – Withdraw cash from ATMs or make payments on terminals locally or internationally.
  • – Make online bill payments, hotel reservations, car rental services and online shopping.
Can my UBA Naira credit card be used internationally?

Yes, your UBA Naira Credit Card can be used locally and internationally at any ATM or POS outlet which has the Visa logo, the Internet, and POS terminals.

How does the monthly repayment cycle work?

The cycle runs from the 15th of every month to the 15th of the next month when the credit card statement showing transactions details within the period and amount due for repayment will be sent to the cardholders’ registered email address.

What is the interest rate charged?

Monthly interest rate of 3% on cash advance (withdrawals made on ATM) and 2.5% on POS/WEB.

Are there any interest free period?

Yes- There is a 45 day interest free period on POS/Web transactions provided 100% repayment is made on the due date. Less than 100% repayment will result in 2.5% charge on the outstanding balance.

How much am I expected to repay monthly and when should repayment be made?
  • You are expected to make at least a minimum monthly repayment of 10% on the outstanding balance. However, customers can opt to repay higher amounts e.g. 20% to100% of the outstanding balance.
  • Fund your repayment account on or before the 30th with the amount for your chosen repayment plan as it will be debited from your account on the 30th of each month.
How do I make repayment?

Fund your repayment account on or before the 30th with the amount for your chosen repayment plan.

What is late repayment fee and why will I be charged?

When you default on the minimum monthly repayment by the 30th of the month being the due date, a late repayment fee being 1% of the outstanding balance from the date it was not paid will be charged to the cardholder.

When did UBA merge with STB?

What is the position regarding taxation of dividends?

The current tax legislation requires that a withholding tax of 10% be deducted at source from all dividend payments.

What is the structure of UBA's issued share capital?

In which currencies does UBA pay its dividend?

When is UBA's Annual General Meeting?

What is a Global Depositary Receipt (GDR)?

  • A GDR is a negotiable certificate representing ownership of shares. GDRs are quoted and traded in US dollars. Also, the dividends are paid to investor in US dollars. GDRs were specifically designed to facilitate the purchase, holding and sale of non-US securities by foreign investors.

Do I need a Certificate of Capital Importation?

Due to capital movement restrictions in Nigeria, a Certificate of Capital Importation (CCI) should be obtained by any investor in order to be able to repatriate funds out of Nigeria. Please note that CCI’s can only be issued to Non-Nigerian domiciled investors.

What is the UBA’s GDR Programme?

UBA runs a GDR programme to enable foreign institutional investors to hold and trade UBA shares without having to expatriate funds into Nigeria.
UBA has run a bifurcated GDR programme since 8 May 1998 under the CUSIPs 90953F104 (144A), symbol UBAFYP and 90953F203 (Reg S). On 20 March 2007, UBA issued new Reg S GDRs to international investors, under a temporary CUSIP 90953F302. It is anticipated that Early in 2008 the programmes will be merged under a single CUSIP.

Who is UBA Group’s depositary for GDRs?

The Bank of New York Mellon. The depositary bank plays a key role in the process of issuance and as cancellation of GDRs. It also maintains the GDR holder register and distributes the dividends in US dollars. For additional information, please visit our profile at the Bank of New York Mellon’s website here.

How can I find out dividend and corporate action information on UBA?

For additional information not contained on this website, please visit www.adrbny.com. Go to the DR Corporate Actions or DR Dividends Distribution buttons on the vertical scroll bar on the left and then enter company name, CUSIP or symbol.

What are the benefits of GDRs to foreign investors?

The GDRs are preferred by some investors who are unable to hold Nigerian securities for compliance reasons or due to a lack of the appropriate infrastructure for holding an Ordinary share (a local custodian). The GDRs also trade, clear and settle according to international market conventions rather than those prevalent in Nigeria.

How are GDR dividends paid?

Dividends are paid in US dollars.

Is it easy to get information and updates on the GDRs?

Investors receive annual reports and proxy materials in English.

Where are UBA GDRs traded?

The GDRs are traded Over-The-Counter. The ratio between the ordinary share and the GDR is 1:200.

  • This is an Instant Loan Product that is fully automated end to end and is enabled on all our digital channels (USSD, Leo WhatsApp and Facebook, Mobile Banking and Internet Banking). It is available to all salaried individuals who receive their monthly emoluments through UBA.

How do I apply for click credit product?

  • To apply for the Click Credit, Dial the USSD Code *919*28# or type “Instant Loan” on any of the aforementioned digital channels.

I want to apply for an instant loan, however, I do not have an account with UBA. What do I do?

To enjoy this product, you would need to operate a salary account with UBA. You could follow the easy steps provided by any of our e-channels which include:

  • USSD Short Code [*919*20#]
  • UBA Mobile Banking Application or
  • Chat with LEO
  • – Search for “UBACHATBANKING” on Facebook with the verified logo (Blue Tick).
  • – Send a “HELLO” to +2349030019007 on WhatsApp.

  • You could also walk into any of our Business Offices nearest to you to open one.

      •  
What is the maximum loan amount I can apply for?
  • You can get up to N 5,000,000.00 (Five million naira)
  •  
What is the maximum loan tenor?
  • You can enjoy flexible loan tenor up to 12 months.
  •  
How long will it take to process a UBA Click Credit request?

  • No Processing and paperwork! Just dial away and obtain your loan in less than a minute!

How do I know if I am eligible for a loan?

  • To be eligible for the loan, customers must have received their salary through UBA for the last 6 months.

I am yet to be a confirmed staff of my firm; can I still get a loan?

  • Confirmation status of applicant in the place of employment is not required for loan eligibility.

What documents am I required to provide to obtain a facility?
    • No documents required. Once again, just dial awayyyyyy!
If I just opened a salary account with UBA, how long do I have to wait before I can apply for the Instant Loan?

  • You must have been receiving your salary through UBA for at least six months before you can be qualified for this product.

Are there fees to be paid to enjoy this product?

  • There are no fees on this product.

What is the applicable interest rate on this product?

  • The applicable interest rate is 19% p.a. (1.58% monthly)

Personal loans

How do I apply for a Personal Loan?

  • To apply for any of our loan facilities, kindly visit our dedicated lending platform Integrated Credit Express (ICE) https://ice.ubagroup.com:8463/kast le/ikastle.html

  • or walk into any of our Business Offices nearest to you or send an E-mail to your Relationship Manager and you will be guided appropriately.

I want to apply for a loan, however, I do not have an account with UBA. What do I do?

  • To enjoy any of our loan facilities, you would need to open a salary account with UBA. You could follow the easy steps provided by any of our e-channels which include:

  • USSD Short Code [*919*20#]
  • UBA Mobile Banking Application or
  • Chat with LEO:
  • – Search for “UBACHATBANKING” on Facebook
  • – Send a “HELLO” to +2349030002455 on WhatsApp.
  • You could also walk into any of our Business Offices nearest to you.
What is the maximum loan amount I can apply for?
  • You can get up to N 30,000,000.00 (Thirty million naira) depending on your salary and other set terms and conditions.
  •  
What is the maximum loan tenor?
  • You can enjoy flexible loan tenor up to 60 months.
  •  
How long will it take to process a UBA Personal Loan request?

  • The UBA Personal Loan facility request takes about 48 hours for loan disbursement, upon receipt of all required documentation.

How do I know if I am eligible for a Personal Loan?

  • To be eligible to obtain a loan facility, the following criteria are to be met:

    • You must be a confirmed staff
    • Your employer must be on the approved list of organizations for Personal Loans
I am yet to be a confirmed staff of my firm, can I still get a loan?

  • No

What documents am I required to provide to obtain a facility?

To obtain the UBA Personal Loan, you would need to provide the following documents:

  • A duly completed Loan Application Form.
  • A copy of your pay slip and bank statement of account indicating salary inflows in the last 6 months.
  • A letter of awareness from your current employer.
I just started working at my company just recently, when will I be eligible to apply?

To be eligible to apply for the UBA Personal Loan Product, you must have been confirmed as a staff by your organisation.

Asset Finance

How does Asset Financing work?

  • This product offers loans to customers whose salaries are domiciled with UBA for acquisition of assets of their choice from any of the approved vendors by the Bank.

What types of asset can be obtained through the Bank?

  • With UBA Asset finance loan, you can acquire the following asset categories:

    • Home appliances
    • Electronic devices
    • Phones
    • Generators
    • Solar systems
    • Furniture
Can I apply for multiple asset?

  • Yes, provided your income can support additional facility subject to approved percentage of your salary for loan repayment.

Can I request for loan to buy required assets from 2 different vendors at the same time?

  • No. However, you can place independent loan requests to acquire assets from different vendors.

Do I need collateral before I can access the loan?
  • No, you do not need additional collateral for asset financing. Asset financed serves as the collateral.
Are there after sales service for the products, like repairs?
  • Yes, there are after sales service on certain items as specified by the vendors.
What is the maximum amount of an asset that I can get a financing for?

  • N3,000,000

What is the minimum amount of an asset that I can get a financing for?
  • N35,000
What is the minimum equity contribution on Asset finance product?

  • Customer is required to make available a minimum equity contribution of 30% of the cost of asset to be acquired, whilst the Bank will provide the balance of the cost as loan.

Auto Loans

How does Auto Loan work?

  • This product offers loans to customers whose salaries are domiciled with UBA for acquisition of automobiles from any of the approved vendors by the Bank.

What types of vehicle can be obtained through the Bank?

  • With UBA Auto loan, you can acquire the following vehicles:

    • Mercedes
    • Honda
    • Hyundai
    • Kia
    • Suzuki
    • Benz
    • Ford
    • Toyota
    • Mitsubishi
    • Nissan
    • Volkswagen
Can I apply for multiple vehicles?

  • Yes, provided your income can support additional facility subject to approved percentage of your salary for loan repayment.

Do I need collateral before I can access the loan?

  • No, you do not need additional collateral for auto financing. Vehicle financed serves as the collateral.

Are there after sales service for the products, like repairs?
  • Yes, there are after sales service on vehicle financed as specified by the retailers.
What is the maximum loan amount on UBA Auto loan product?
  • N15,000,000
What is the minimum equity contribution on Auto loan?

  • Customer is required to contribute at the minimum 30% of the cost of vehicle to be acquired whilst the Bank will provide the balance of the cost as loan.

Is insurance mandatory on financed vehicle?

  • Yes, all financed vehicles will be insured by insurance companies approved by the Bank.

Security

What We Do

• We employ industry-proven standards and technologies to protect information in our computing environment.
• We protect our systems and networks from the Internet with Firewall systems.
• We use 128-bit SSL encryption technology to protect sensitive information that is transmitted over the Internet.
• We maintain a Global Digital Certificate signed by Verisign® that assures you are, in fact, communicating directly with UBA Bank.
• We control access to your information inside our company by limiting employee access to systems and data.

What You Should Do

• Protect your username and password. Avoid choosing easily guessed words or numbers. Avoid writing your Sign In information in a place where others can view it.
• Use the “Sign Out” button to Sign Out from Online Account Access upon completion of your session and close your browser.
• Do not use email for account-specific questions. Email is not normally encrypted and your account information could be intercepted.
• Review your statement information regularly for unauthorized transactions.

Alerts Regarding Phishing and Web-Spoofing

• Phishing is an internet scam (spoof) in the form of an email or pop-up box. The emails and pop-ups link to sites that look like well-known legitimate businesses and ask you to provide and confirm personal, financial, or password information.
• Legitimate businesses do not ask for this information unless you initiate a request for a service. Please DO NOT RESPOND to these emails requesting personal identity, accounts or password information.
• Scam emails often contain misspelled words, poor grammar, awkward or unprofessional writing and typos.
• Be suspicious of urgent or alarming appeals that request security information.
• If you believe you have received a phishing email that claims to be from UBA Bank forward the suspicious email to cfc@ubagroup.com
• To learn other ways to avoid email scams and deal with deceptive spam visit the Federal Trade Commission site at www.ftc.gov/spam

SME

What is the SME Business Account?
The SME Business Account is designed to support micro, small and medium-sized businesses, which are deterred by CAMF charges to own a business current account. The UBA SME account will offer very minimum fees with lots of value-added propositions to enable MSMEs build capacity. The account is in three variants, representing different turnover bands and monthly fees.
Which sectors are eligible to apply for this account?
All MSME sectors and segments with maximum annual turnover of N600MM
I wish to know if there is a maximum threshold for each band?
Each of the Variants have a band with a maximum limit at the Medium category.
PARAMETER MICRO SMALL SMALL
SCHEME CODE SMEMI SMSML SMMED
Opening Balance 20,000 100,000 500,000
Monthly Minimum Turnover Band N2.5M-9.99M N10M-49.99M N50M-100M
Fixed Monthly Charge (VAT Inclusive) N1,050 N5,250 N10,500
Default CAMF (if turnover falls below Minimum Turnover) N1/Mille on Turnover N0.9/Mille on Turnove N0.8/Mille on Turnover
Is the SME Business Account a COT-free account?
Cot free when customer achieves his/her minimum threshold.
Can an existing customer who has a personal current account be able to migrate to the new SME Business Account?
Yes. You can do a scheme code change for an active account. You can also resuscitate dormant account into this new account.
Which variant does customers with a monthly turnover of above 100 Million belong to
Customer with turnover above 100 Million can do the medium VARIANT of the SME account. We will only charge such customer a concessionary CAMF of N0.6/mille for the excess of 100 million in a particular month.
Is the Minimum opening balance the same as minimum operating balance for the SME Business Account?

There is no Minimum operating balance but a minimum opening balance.

If customer exceeds the maximum amount, will they be charged?
Customer is charged the Fixed Monthly Charge for the width the customer exceeded into.
What are the benefits of having an SME Business account?
  • Fixed Monthly Charges
  • Access to business loans
  • On boarding on digital collection solutions
  • Access to MSME masterclasses and advisory.
  • Access to the bank’s SME events and fairs.
  • Access to a free online marketplace (as applicable)

Teens Account

What is UBA Teens Account?

UBA Teens is a basic savings account for teenagers. The objective of the account is to give them a sense of inclusion in planning their finances, carrying out transactions and learning to save.

What are the key benefits of the UBA Teens Account?

– 50% discount on first debit card issuance
– 13th Month Reward with a maintenance of an SI for 12 months at a minimum of N5,000 (Target-Plan). 10% of the monthly Target plan amount is paid to the customer
– Consistent maintenance of SI above N10,000 for 6 month stand a chance to partake in the Scholarship scheme
– Opportunity for Internship with the Bank

What are the requirements for opening a UBA Teens Account?

Forms
– Personal Account Opening Form (To be completed by parents with parent’s information or with guardian’s information)
– Signature Specimen form (To be completed by parent or guardian)
Documents required
– Birth Certificate or international passport of the child/teenager.
– One passport photo each of parent or guardian and child/teenager
– Valid and acceptable means of Identification for parent/guardian (e.g. Intl. Passport/Driver’s License/Voters Card)
– Recent Utility bill
Funds
– Minimum Opening Balance of N3,000
– Minimum Operating Balance of N 1,000

Who Operates the UBA TEENS Account?

-The parent/ guardian till the child comes of age

Can I get a debit card on the account?

Yes. First issuance is at a discount of 50%.

Who can request for a UBA Teens card?

New-to-Bank Teen customers by completing the Teens Debit Card section of the Account Opening Form.
Existing Teen customers by completing the Teens Debit Card section of the Debit Card Request Form

How much do I have to pay for the debit card?

The debit card is at 50% discount  for first issuance  and the standard charge applies for lost or expired cards.

How can I check my child’s balance or recent transactions?

Parents/guardians can monitor teens’ account activity including balance information and recent transactions through online banking/Mobile App/USSD.

Can I transfer money from my child’s account to my account with UBA?

Yes. As the signatory on the account, you can transfer money from your child’s account to another account at UBA.

Can I transfer money into my child’s account?

Yes. You can either deposit cash or transfer into the account.

Can I transfer funds to a non-UBA Bank Account?

Yes. But Only from a full KYC Teens account

Can I still open a UBA TEENS account without a valid means of ID and utility bill?

Yes

What if a teen wants to change his/her transaction limit without the parent/guardian’s consent?

Transaction limits can only be defined and changed by parents/guardians. In addition, parents/guardians can monitor teens’ account activity through online/mobile/USSD banking.

Are other bank cheques allowed into UBA teens account?

Yes. But only for a full KYC Teens account

What is the 13th month reward and how do I partake in this?

The 13th month reward is an amount paid to UBA Teens customers at the end of each year. If they save according to their target plan and roll over their balance to the next year (not withdrawn). Kindly submit a standing instruction of a minimum of N5,000 to begin.

Will I qualify for the 13th month bonus if I do not have a target saving plan?

NO, you will not qualify for the 13th month bonus if you do not have a target savings plan

What happens to my 13th month bonus if I withdraw funds early?

If you withdraw funds early, you will not be eligible for the 13th month bonus that year.

However, your plan will remain in effect and you can be eligible the following year if you stick to your plan. In this case, your plan will revert to Year 1, so you will be eligible for a 10% bonus that year.

Will I still earn interest if I do not achieve my target plan?

Yes, you will earn competitive interest on the accumulated funds in your account even if you do not achieve your target plan –however you will no longer be eligible for the 13th month bonus.

How do I sign up for the scholarship reward?

To begin, simply maintain a Standing Instruction of minimum of N10,000 for 6 consecutive months (Without withdrawals)
